name: typed-prompt
description: A prompt line types itself in chunked human cadence behind a deterministic blinking caret, with optional backspace-and-retype correction of the final word.

vars.description: Leading glyph before the typed line. Empty string hides it.
Keystroke rhythm: uniform fixed steps or seeded human chunks.
Blink runs integer sine cycles during typing then goes solid.
Mistyped word typed in place of the final word, then backspaced and corrected. Empty disables.
Comma-separated seconds relative to mount start; cue N anchors the start of word N. Empty uses the authored rhythm.
Color of the prompt glyph and caret.
Outgoing transition. Frame roots own transitions; none holds the end frame.
